_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Home#000.src: What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
A Journey Home#000.dst: ここは何だ？こんな技術、どうやって造ったのか想像もつかない。

A Journey Home#001.src: The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
A Journey Home#001.dst: キャラバンの御者は姿を消したようだ…機械仕掛けの車両をいくつか調べれば、何か見つかるかもしれない。

A Journey Home#002.src: {p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
A Journey Home#002.dst: {p} と Fruma の関係は、Wynn の腐敗と戦うために気前よく送り出される新兵だけに限られている。

A Journey Home#003.src: They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way
A Journey Home#003.dst: 締め出された。ここからは入れない…だが、来た道を戻ったら

A Journey Home#004.src: ...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
A Journey Home#004.dst: …ああ。そうか。つまり…うまくいかなかったのだな。他の者は皆戻ったのか？

A Journey Home#006.src: Is there anything I can do for you today?
A Journey Home#006.dst: 今日は何かご用ですか？

A Journey Home#007.src: ...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
A Journey Home#007.dst: …頭の奥で何かがちくりとする。初めてここに来た時も、こうして眠っていなかったか？

A Journey Home#008.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Fruma Gate を調べる。

A Journey Home#009.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#009.dst: 初めて Wynn に着いた場所の近くを探索する。

A Journey Home#011.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#011.dst: 道を戻って Fruma へ向かう。

A Journey Home#012.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#012.dst: こんな仕事無理だって！！ そもそも何で私がここに？！
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#013.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#013.dst: あっ！ 兵士の方ですよね？ その、私は…今は本当に大変な時でして。
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#014.dst: この、この事態は完全に私の手に負えません！ どう対処すればいいのか…
A Journey Home#014.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#015.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#015.dst: いえ、それはともかく…ええと。何のご用でしょう？
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#016.dst: あ。ああ、まずい。ええと、それは問題になりそうです。そもそも国境で何をするんですか？
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#017.dst: 国境に何の用があるのか想像もつきませんが、何であれ後回しです！ Corkus 製のドリルは動かないし、Paxon は立ち往生、それに
A Journey Home#017.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#018.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#018.dst: すみません…つい当たってしまって。私は軍事作戦の訓練は受けても、落盤処理は専門外なんです。でも他に誰もいなくて！
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#019.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#019.dst: 雇った爆破の専門家まで行き詰まってて、もう何もかもうまくいかない。どうしたらいいのか。
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#020.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#020.dst: あそこに新しい入口があるでしょう？ 専門家の Paxon は、私がこのポンコツと格闘してたのと同じくらい長く中にいます。
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#021.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#021.dst: 専門家よりうまくやれると思うなら話してみてください。でも、あなたの予定はきっと取り消しになりますよ。
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#022.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#022.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Demolition Mage と話す。

A Journey Home#023.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#023.dst: どうしても国境へ行きたいなら、新しい洞窟の入口にいる Paxon と話すのが一番です。
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#024.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#024.dst: でも専門家ですから、あなたの用事は待つことになるでしょう。本当に、本当にすみません！
A Journey Home#024.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#025.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#025.dst: ああもう、また来た。階級なんか関係ない、あんたの頼みは無理だって！ 私でさえ、これは
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#026.dst: 待って、あんたはあっちの…じゃない。ただの兵士か。ここを通りたいだけなんでしょ？
A Journey Home#026.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#027.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#027.dst: 今すぐ諦めな！ 無理。絶対に無理。時間の無駄だよ、その理由をきっちり教えてあげる。
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#028.dst: あそこの青い岩が見える？ あれが破砕点。そこで爆薬を爆発させれば道が開く。
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: They're gone. Hurry down the path!
A Journey Home#029.dst: 行ったぞ。急いで道を下れ！

A Journey Home#030.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#030.dst: でも、ここにある設備は全部大事だから、少しでも壊したり「動かしたり」するのは許されないんだって！
A Journey Home#030.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#031.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#031.dst: しかも中尉がドリルの作業中も私を「監督」できるように、起爆装置はここに置かなきゃだめ。
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#032.dst: だから限られた爆薬を岩までつなげて連鎖させなきゃいけない。設備は一つも吹き飛ばさずに！
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#033.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#033.dst: 何時間もやってるのにまったく進まない！ これでもこの分野じゃ一流なのに！ ばかげてる！！
A Journey Home#033.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#034.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
A Journey Home#034.dst: 時間を無駄にしたいなら、これが私の爆薬の在庫。好きに試していいけど、本当はさっさと行ったほうがいい。
A Journey Home#034.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
A Journey Home#035.dst: TNT を使って洞窟に道を開く。

A Journey Home#036.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#036.dst: まだやってるの？ 何、もう一回説明がいる？ どうせ暇だし。
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#037.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#037.dst: 青い岩は爆薬で砕けるくらい柔らかい。でも起爆装置はここから動かせない。
A Journey Home#037.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#038.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#038.dst: だから TNT Placer で起爆装置から爆発を連鎖させる。テントも木箱も壁も吹き飛ばさずにね。
A Journey Home#038.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#039.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#039.dst: 置いた TNT を見れば、爆発範囲もわかるよ。
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#040.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#040.dst: でも設備同士の隙間があれだけ狭いと、どうやっても無理だね。
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#041.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#041.dst: 言ったでしょ、おとなしく城に戻ったほうがいい。私が無理なら、あんたもうまくいかないよ。
A Journey Home#041.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#044.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#044.dst: 止まれ！ どこから来た？ この先で落盤があったはずだろう？
A Journey Home#044.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#045.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#045.dst: 新しい道だと？ こんな所に用があるとは思わなかったが、ありがたくないとは言わんよ。
A Journey Home#045.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#046.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#046.dst: grook の巣まで潰れてな。ここ数日は野戦食で食いつないでる。で、どこへ行くんだ？
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#047.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#047.dst: 国境？ そこへ向かうなら、きっと重要な公務なんだろう。だが、待ってもらうことになるかもしれん。
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#048.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#048.dst: 橋の修理はやっつけ仕事でな。君の重さに耐えられないかもしれん。落盤が片付いたから、ちゃんと直せるかもしれんが…
A Journey Home#048.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#049.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#049.dst: だが時間がかかる。私なら引き返すね。どんな用事だろうと、命には代えられんよ。
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#051.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#051.dst: そういえば、君に見覚えがある気がする。この仕事じゃ珍しいことだ。
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#052.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#052.dst: 本当にそれだけの価値がある用事なのか？ あの橋はひどくぐらつく。君を失いたくはない。
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#053.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#053.dst: 道を戻って Fruma へ向かう。

A Journey Home#054.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#054.dst: おい、そこのお前！ 通る前にこっちへ来い。
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#055.dst: おい！ まずこっちへ来い、新兵！
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#056.dst: 行きも帰りも関係ない。先へ進む兵士を呼び止めて装備を確認しろと厳命されている。
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#057.dst: 例外はない、どんな理由でもだ。特に川向こうの落盤以来はな！
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#058.dst: 命より大事なものはない。まともな装備なしで進めば、その命を落としかねんぞ！
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#059.dst: よし、見せてみろ。規定どおりの装備か確かめてやる。
A Journey Home#059.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#060.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#060.dst: さて、その装備が規定を満たしているか見せてもらおう。
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#061.dst: ふむ…ああ、やっぱり傷だらけだ…鎧は磨かれてない…武器は今にも壊れそうだ…
A Journey Home#061.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#062.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#062.dst: そんな錆びたガラクタでよくここまで来られたな！ それじゃ身を守れんぞ！
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#063.dst: いいか、すぐそこの洞窟に宝箱がある。中に入って、まともな装備を手に入れてこい。
A Journey Home#063.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#064.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#064.dst: …そうか？ なら、この先をもう一度よく見てみるんだな。
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#065.dst: わかったか？ レベルがどうのと言い訳するな。装備を整えるか、通らないかだ！ 命を賭けさせはせん。
A Journey Home#065.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#066.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#066.dst: 洞窟にはいい物がある。俺の隣のこれみたいにな。さっさと行け。
A Journey Home#066.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#067.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#067.dst: 言っただろう、行きも帰りもだ。何があろうと、先へ進む前にこの洞窟で装備を整えろ。
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#068.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#068.dst: よし。その洞窟に宝箱があるから、必要な物は全部見つかるはずだ。行け！
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#069.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.
A Journey Home#069.dst: 洞窟を探索して戦利品を見つける。

A Journey Home#070.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#070.dst: 洞窟に入って宝箱を開けろ。
A Journey Home#070.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#071.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#071.dst: 道を戻って Fruma へ向かう。

A Journey Home#072.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#072.dst: それらしいな。その鎧はすぐそこの Item Identifier で鑑定すれば、装備できるようになる。
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#073.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#073.dst: しかし…国境へ戻ろうとしているようだが…理由を聞かねばならん。珍しいことだ。{p} へ戻ったほうがいい。
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#074.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#074.dst: 逆方向へ行くお前を他の新兵が見たら、混乱したり、やる気をなくすかもしれん。そんな危険は冒したくないだろう？
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#075.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#075.dst: 本当にそれだけの価値があるのか？ 町へ戻ったほうがいいんじゃないか。
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#076.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.
A Journey Home#076.dst: 道にいる Fruman Recruit を避ける。

A Journey Home#077.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#077.dst: …戦のために Fruma の兵士を集めてるんだ。向こうは相当ひどいらしい。不安になるよ…
A Journey Home#077.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#078.dst: 歩く死体を甘く見る気はないけど、悪いことばかりってわけじゃないよな？
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#079.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#079.dst: この門を越えればわかるさ。ここが国境だ…深呼吸、深呼吸…
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#080.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#080.dst: …Wynn のこと何か知ってる？ 説明を何も受けてないんだ。
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#081.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#081.dst: 噂を覚えてる…偉大な英雄がいるとか。名前は…R で始まる？
A Journey Home#081.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#082.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#082.dst: 機会があったらすぐ聞くことにしよう。戦いでは情報が鍵だ。
A Journey Home#082.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#083.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#083.dst: …ひどい御者だよ。気の毒だけど、いつもあの岩にぶつかるって本人が言ってた。自業自得じゃないか。
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#084.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#084.dst: 車輪よりシャリのことで頭がいっぱいだ。何日も食べてない気がする。道が短いといいな…
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#085.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#085.dst: 御者がもっとまともなら、空きっ腹でこんなに歩かずに済んだのに！ 急いでごちそうにありつこうぜ？
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#086.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#086.dst: 待って、あれは誰？ なんで国境の方から来るんだ？？
A Journey Home#086.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#087.dst: キャラバンの御者から隠れる。

A Journey Home#088.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#088.dst: …これで今日の分は終わりだ。
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#089.dst: 今日は二人組が多かったな。あと八人控えてる…だがそいつは明日だ。
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#090.dst: またあの岩か…またあの台詞だ。いつか変えさせてもらえねえかな。毎回うんざりだ…
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#091.dst: まあ、そういうことだ。さて、行くとするか…自分で選んだ我が家へ。そこなら面倒も追ってこねえ。
A Journey Home#091.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#092.dst: Fruma Gate の先を探索する。

A Journey Home#093.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#093.dst: 察しが悪いにもほどがあるな？
A Journey Home#093.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#094.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#094.dst: うまくやったつもりだろう。俺が残って見てたのにも気づかなかったろ？ 甘く見るなよ。
A Journey Home#094.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#095.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#095.dst: いいか、こういうことは初めてじゃない- わかるだろ。誰かが好奇心を起こして、来た道をたどり直すのさ。
A Journey Home#095.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#096.src: ...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
A Journey Home#096.dst: …お前に求めることは一つだけだ。何が起きても…生きて帰ってこい。

A Journey Home#097.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#097.dst: わからなかったなら言うが、これは全部片道の旅のはずなんだ。橋も、落盤も、お前を引き止めようとする連中もな。
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#098.dst: ここにいるのは賢くない。なにせ三人組の中で残る許可を得たのはお前じゃない。ああ、大会の結果は聞いてる。
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#099.src: He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
A Journey Home#099.dst: ぐっすり眠っている。頭の真上で教会の鐘を鳴らしても起きないだろう。

A Journey Home#100.src: That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
A Journey Home#100.dst: それっぽいな。ほらな？難しくなかっただろ。よし、じゃあ行け！

A Journey Home#101.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#101.dst: だから…選択肢は二つだ、相棒。この件は俺たちの間で水に流せる。本当だ。まっすぐ {p} へ戻れば、俺は口をつぐむ。
A Journey Home#101.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#102.src: Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
A Journey Home#102.dst: 残念ながら、この件では手が出せないのだ。私にできることはほとんどない。会議で私が言ったことを覚えているだろう。

A Journey Home#103.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#103.dst: あるいは、危ない橋を渡って俺と {p} 行きの列車に乗るかだ。早く決めな、もうすぐ出るぞ。
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#104.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#104.dst: 客車でお前を見かけたら、まあ…そういうことだ。どうなるかは待ってのお楽しみだな。
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#105.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#105.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の客車でキャラバンの御者と合流する。

A Journey Home#106.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#106.dst: 引き返す最後のチャンスだ。それがお前の選択か？
A Journey Home#106.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#107.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#107.dst: なら、{p} までの長い道のりを歩いて帰るんだな。
A Journey Home#107.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#111.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#111.dst: 好奇心は猫をも殺すって言うだろう。お前は満足すれば猫が生き返ると信じるクチか？
A Journey Home#111.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#112.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#112.dst: さてと、「子猫ちゃん」、見つけたのはクリームじゃなくて- 猟犬だったな。
A Journey Home#112.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#113.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#113.dst: Fruma への侵入者、お前を逮捕する！ さあ歩け！
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#114.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#114.dst: 御者が味方だと本気で思ったのか、侵入者？ 愚か者め。手を引く機会は何度も与えたのに、ここまで来るとはな。行くぞ。
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#115.dst: 指揮官！ 至急お話が！
A Journey Home#115.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#116.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#116.dst: 門から緊急の報告があります。
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#117.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#117.dst: 本当に急ぎなら、聞こう。
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#118.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#118.dst: 兵士たち！ 侵入者を押さえておけ。お前たちを信頼している。
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#119.dst: 衛兵を倒して脱出する。

A Journey Home#122.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#122.dst: 何か手伝えることはあるかい？
A Journey Home#122.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#123.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#123.dst: ふむ。まあ害はねえだろう。だが気をつけな、いいな？
A Journey Home#123.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#124.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#124.dst: ここは俺たちの家だ。何か荒らされたら、あまりいい顔はできねえ。わかったか？
A Journey Home#124.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#125.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#125.dst: …まあ、なんだかんだでうまくやってるよ。天気もいいしな。祭りも近い。
A Journey Home#125.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#126.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#126.dst: だが、それは俺たちの知ったこっちゃねえ。他に用がねえなら、そろそろお引き取り願おうか。
A Journey Home#126.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#127.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#127.dst: ふむ。よし。じゃあ、いい一日を。
A Journey Home#127.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#128.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#128.dst: あら？ どちら様でしょう？
A Journey Home#128.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#129.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#129.dst: ほほ、まあいいでしょう。何かお手伝いしましょうか？
A Journey Home#129.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#130.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#130.dst: ああ、ちょっとした金属加工の作業をしているんです。ここでは何かしら交換や手入れが必要でして…
A Journey Home#130.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#131.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#131.dst: もっとも、私は専門家ではありませんよ！ でも道具はそれなりに扱えますし、この作業にはそれで十分です。
A Journey Home#131.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#132.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#132.dst: さようなら、旅の方！ 無事に帰れますように。
A Journey Home#132.speaker: Mora
